column1: # The suite (plugin/scripts/invocation-forms.test.sh) reads this file and enforces five rules:
#   - a listed case that fails prints KNOWN GAP and is not a failure;
#   - a listed case that passes fails the run (the line is stale: the slice that fixes it has landed);
#   - a listed case that fails with ANOTHER exit code than the fourth field records fails the run, so a crash or a
#     refused argument cannot hide behind a known gap;
#   - a line whose key names no case fails the run;
#   - the lines are sorted by key, so a slice removes only its own line and two slices never edit the same one.
# A slice that fixes its line deletes that line in the same commit as the fix, and adds the case's controls and the
# negative case to the suite. Do not renumber, reorder or reformat other slices' lines.
# A key of a case carried to a later release says so in the reason. The two action-report-mode-with-value cases are NOT
# listed: they pass on 0.9.55. The 0.9.55 audit reported exit 64 for them because its Action probe ran in a directory
# where the bundle path it passed does not exist, and okf-check answers 64 for a folder that is not there — the code
# this file records for a missing bundle, not a wrong report.
